scientific_integrity: Proof reconstructs every free face and stabilizer condition and identifies the integer chain complex; runnable finite checks cover several complete and noncomplete graphs. No authorship, expert certification, or external independent mathematical validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The construction is proved for finite simple graphs of minimum degree at least three. For complete graphs, the full integral symmetric-group lattice is specified, but no equivariant sphere-wedge decomposition is asserted; the earlier nonequivariant wedge calculation, general non-equivariant equivalence, and rational characters are not presented as novel. The finite checks do not certify the general theorem. Equivalent unindexed equivariant collapse statements remain possible.
title: An equivariant star-collapse model for line-graph clique complexes
